  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: false
    anchor-sections: false
    theme: ../assets/style/page/contact.scss

---

```{=html}
<div class="page-contact__body">

  <div class="page-contact__form-wrap">
    <h2>Send a message</h2>
    <p>This form opens your email client with a pre-addressed message to <a href="support@openspaceproject.com">support@openspaceproject.com</a>. Use that email address or the Slack to get in touch!</p>
    <form id="contact-form" novalidate>
      <div class="page-contact__form-field">
        <label for="cf-name">Name</label>
        <input type="text" id="cf-name" name="name" placeholder="Your name" autocomplete="name">
      </div>
      <div class="page-contact__form-field">
        <label for="cf-email">Email <span class="page-contact__form-required">*</span></label>
        <input type="email" id="cf-email" name="email" placeholder="your@email.com" autocomplete="email" required>
      </div>
      <div class="page-contact__form-field">
        <label for="cf-subject">Subject</label>
        <input type="text" id="cf-subject" name="subject" placeholder="What's this about?">
      </div>
      <div class="page-contact__form-field">
        <label for="cf-message">Message <span class="page-contact__form-required">*</span></label>
        <textarea id="cf-message" name="message" placeholder="Tell us what you need…" required></textarea>
      </div>
      <p class="page-contact__form-error" id="cf-error" hidden></p>
      <button type="submit" class="button__primary">Send message</button>
    </form>
  </div>

  <div class="page-contact__slack-wrap">
    <h2>Also on Slack</h2>
    <p>For real-time help, the OpenSpace Slack is active with community members, educators, and developers.</p>
    <a class="button__secondary" href="/community/slack.html">Join the Slack</a>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
(() => {
  let form = document.getElementById('contact-form');
  if (!form) return;

  form.addEventListener('submit', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    let errorEl = document.getElementById('cf-error');

    let email = form.querySelector('#cf-email').value.trim();
    let message = form.querySelector('#cf-message').value.trim();

    if (!email || !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
      errorEl.textContent = 'Please enter a valid email address.';
      errorEl.hidden = false;
      return;
    }
    if (!message) {
      errorEl.textContent = 'Please enter a message.';
      errorEl.hidden = false;
      return;
    }
    errorEl.hidden = true;

    let name = form.querySelector('#cf-name').value.trim();
    let subject = form.querySelector('#cf-subject').value.trim() || 'OpenSpace inquiry';
    let body = `${(name ? `From: ${name}\n` : '')}Email: ${email}\n\n${message}`;

    window.location.href = 'mailto:support@openspaceproject.com' +
      `?subject=${encodeURIComponent(subject)}` + `&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`;
  });
})();
</script>
```
